preconditions.description: A and B must be strings.
The length of A and B must be between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value must be -1 if transformation is not possible, otherwise it must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(B[i] in A for i in range(len(B)))
postconditions.description: If transformation is possible, every character in B must be present in A.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (len(B) == len(A) and return_value <= len(A))
postconditions.description: If transformation is possible, the length of B must equal the length of A, and the return value must not exceed the length of A.
